title: GTA 6 Original Soundtrack Revealed with 34 Songs
description: Grand Theft Auto 6's original soundtrack has been partially revealed, featuring 34 original tracks from real-world artists, with six available now.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Original Soundtrack Partially Revealed: 34 Tracks and Real-World Artists

As anticipation continues to build for Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world crime epic, new details regarding the game's audio experience have emerged. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the original soundtrack for *Grand Theft Auto 6* has been partially revealed, giving fans a first look at the musical direction of the game.

### A Massive 34-Song Original Soundtrack

Based on the report, the full album for *GTA 6* will contain a total of **34 original tracks** crafted specifically for the upcoming title. Furthermore, these tracks feature music from multiple real-world artists. Rockstar Games has always placed a massive emphasis on the audio landscape of the *Grand Theft Auto* franchise, and the addition of a dedicated original soundtrack featuring external musical talent highlights the scale and ambition of the project.

While the complete tracklist remains under wraps for now, the inclusion of 34 original songs suggests that players can expect a deeply immersive auditory experience while navigating the game's expansive open world and engaging in its criminal underworld.

### Stream Six Tracks Today

For eager fans looking to get a taste of the game's soundscape ahead of launch, the wait is partially over. The report notes that players can **stream six tracks today**. Making a portion of the original soundtrack available for streaming immediately allows the community to engage with the game's musical identity long before the title officially drops.

### Context and Fan Expectations

Music has always been a core pillar of the *GTA* experience, defining the culture and atmosphere of each fictional city. While previous entries heavily relied on licensed radio stations to set the mood, introducing a substantial collection of 34 original tracks demonstrates an evolution in how Rockstar curates in-game audio. Industry observers and fans alike will be watching closely to see how these real-world artist collaborations mesh with the chaotic freedom of the open-world gameplay.

## Editor's Take
Rockstar knows that music defines the soul of *Grand Theft Auto*. Dropping 34 original tracks with real-world artist collaborations—and letting us stream six of them right now—is a brilliant way to fuel the hype train. It proves that the audio department is crafting something truly special for *GTA 6*.
